sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Graduate recruitment started too late this year.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: We lost our top three candidates to companies that made offers earlier.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Next year we start graduate recruitment in September instead of January.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Yes.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Our three best candidates accepted earlier offers elsewhere.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: We just started too late.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We'll begin graduate recruitment in September next year, not January.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The onboarding survey feedback was mixed.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: People liked the buddy system.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: But the first week had too many presentations.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We cut the first-week presentations in half and keep the buddy system.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Makes sense.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Week one is presentation overload.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The buddy system was popular, though.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Buddies stay, and we halve the presentations in week one.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The exit interviews keep raising the same point.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Most leavers said they never had a career conversation with their manager.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Managers say they don't know how to run one.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Every manager holds a career conversation with each report twice a year, and we train them first.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: That's overdue.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Managers tell us they don't know how to have career conversations.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: And leavers say that's exactly what was missing.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We train managers and make a career conversation twice a year mandatory for every report.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Good.
